questions.stem: The rate-limiting step in noradrenaline synthesis is inhibited by:
questions.solutionHtml:
Metyrosine
  • Rate limiting step in noradrenaline synthesis is tyrosine hydroxylase and Tyrosine hydroxylase is inhibited by metyrosine.

questions.stem: A patient was given IV penicillin and suddenly developed a rash on the skin, swelling of lips and eyelids, hypotension, and difficulty in breathing. DOC in the above condition is:
questions.solutionHtml:
1:1000 adrenaline IM route
  • It is a case of Anaphylactic shock. The drug of choice is adrenaline.
  • Adrenaline 0.3-0.5 mg 1/1000 IM. Intramuscular injection may be the preferred route of administration since skin blood flow (and hence systemic drug absorption from subcutaneous injection) is unpredictable in hypotensive patients.



Lange Katzung, Basic & Clinical Pharmacology, 14th Edition, Page Number: 152

questions.stem: A 25year old newly married male person took 3 tablets of Sildenafil to get a sustained erection. After 5 hours of taking the drug, the person had still an erection with progressive pain and got worried. He comes to the emergency ward with the above problem. what is the drug used for the management?

options.label: D
options.text: Reassure the patient, no need for any drug

questions.solutionHtml:
Intra cavernosal phenylephrine
  • This is a case of Priapism caused by PDE V inhibitor Sildenafil. Priapism for more than 4 hrs runs the risk of ischemic damage to cavernosal smooth muscle and sinusoidal epithelium
  • Priapism is an Erection lasting more than four hours or unrelated to sexual interest or stimulation.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 12th Edition, Page Number: 310

questions.stem: A highly selective alpha 2 agonist was used for short-term sedation of critically ill adult patients. The drug is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Dexmedetomidine
  • It is an imidazole derivative and is a highly selective α2 adrenergic receptor agonist
  • For short-term sedation of critically ill adult patients and sedation before and/or during surgical or other medical procedures in non-intubated patients.
  • Activation of the α2a adrenergic receptor by dexmedetomidine produces both sedation and analgesia but does not reliably provide general anesthesia, even at maximal doses


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 12th Edition, Page Number: 310

questions.stem: Hyperkalaemia immediate management is all except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Magnesium
  • The intravenous administration of 1 to 2 g MgSO4 reportedly is effective in preventing recurrent episodes of torsades de pointes, even if the serum Mg2+ concentration is normal.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page No. 567, 568

questions.stem: Prazosin is used under the following conditions except
questions.solutionHtml:
Postural hypotension

  • Prazosin is a selective α1 antagonist used for
    • Hypertension
    • Peripheral vascular disease
    • Scorpion sting
  • It blocks sympathetically mediated vasoconstriction and produces a fall in BP

 



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 155
